title: lithodora nitida
intro: Lithodora nitida, commonly known as Blue Star or Starflower, is a flowering plant species in the borage family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its calming effects and health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Lithodora nitida include acting as a sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic, which contribute to its use in treating conditions like restlessness and muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents present in Lithodora nitida include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
